name: Lidocaine (systemic)
dosing: IV bolus for arrhythmia 1-1.5mg/kg; infusion per protocol. Toxic doses vary
contraindications: Severe heart block without pacemaker, severe SA node dysfunction
monitoring: ECG, signs of local anaesthetic systemic toxicity (LAST)
sideEffects: CNS toxicity (tremor, seizures), cardiac toxicity at high doses
clinicalPearls: Monitor levels with infusion; treat LAST with lipid emulsion therapy
